description: The Microgrid EMS Simulation author publishes a Python platform for benchmarking supervisory energy-management controllers under bounded execution time. Zenodo archives version 0.1.0 under MIT and links the public repository. The README describes deterministic synthetic solar, wind, load and battery profiles, several controller families, grid-compliance and battery-stress metrics, runtime measurements and reference outputs. A modeller can compare control rules for islanded or grid-connected microgrid scenarios before selecting operational logic. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark platform. Coverage is synthetic profiles and defined controller cases, not measurements from a named utility microgrid. A limitation is that the benchmark does not by itself validate controller safety on physical hardware; time bounds, battery ageing and grid constraints depend on the selected assumptions. The repository mentions a manuscript but does not establish deployment results. Neither source archive nor reference outputs were downloaded, and no controller run was reproduced.
